args.body: Hi Lena, while running a catalog query today, I discovered an error from the 2026-10-14 price update: 22 products under fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 through P-1222) were mistakenly included in the 3% price increase. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 through SO-77317) have been placed at these higher prices, resulting in an overcharge of $4,128.60. Recommended next steps: 1) Revert list prices for P-1201 through P-1222 to their pre-increase rates; 2) Issue credits/refunds for orders SO-77310 through SO-77317. Please confirm how you'd like to proceed.
